entities.summary: Viktor Aleksandrovich Hartmann or Gartman was a Russian architect and painter. He was associated with the Abramtsevo Colony, purchased and preserved beginning in 1870 by Savva Mamontov, and the Russian Revival. Viktor Hartmann was a architects & engineers from Saint Petersburg (1834-05-05, Saint Petersburg–1873-08-04). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
